target: S9 definition (docs/PLAN.md S9 row; docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-25 'cage centre translation', METHODS_COMPARISON.md:30 'Expulsion = net translation of the cage centre, not spin') and the future L1 / L1b slip-out metric
claim: S9 and the posterior limit are measured only as the translation of the cage centre. The cord is threatened by the posterior-most point of the cage, not by its centre, and the designer is free to exploit the difference. (1) Spin: rotation about the disc normal is explicitly excluded, and axial rotation is now the window with the largest face twist (about 1.1 N m through each glued face, F-0012). A cage that spins 4.1 deg with its centre fixed moves a corner 0.5 mm, using a ~7 mm half-diagonal for p062's 92.83 mm^2 footprint. That reaches the posterior limit while S9 reads 0. If the spin ratchets over the 3 cycles it is not counted at all. (2) Compliant appendages: the evo material field allows soft PLCL (E 8.2 MPa) parts. A design with a hard, well-fixed core and soft posterior lobes can have its lobes move or bulge toward the canal by more than 0.5 mm while the centroid moves less than 0.5 mm. Whether the 'centre' is the volume centroid, the hard-core centroid or a reference node is not defined anywhere. (3) Separation: S9 does not ask whether a face lifts off (zero contact area) during a window. A cage that loses contact on one endplate in extension and is held only by the other is 'fixed' by the metric but has no friction reserve on the lost face.
evidence: PLAN.md S9 row ('cage-centre translation <= 1 mm relative to C3 and C4 ... posterior net migration <= 0.5 mm'); METHODS_COMPARISON.md:30; DECISIONS.md 2026-10-25 PI entry; work/agents/redteam/r0002_i001_result.json p062_gpu2 AR_left / AR_right max |Mz| 1099-1128 N mm; p062 case.json footprint_area_mm2 92.83, E_soft 8.194; arithmetic in work/agents/redteam/r0002_notes.md section F-0016 (r * theta, r ~ 6.95 mm, theta 0.0873 rad -> 0.61 mm). Tied h15 runs already show tension (lift-off) area fractions up to 0.47 on a face (physio_fix/p062_gpu2/summary.json, bot_tension_area_frac 0.472 at t 4.0).
how_to_reproduce: Read the cited definitions; compute r * theta for the footprint.

fix_options.option: Safety guard + PI: measure S9 on the cage's whole surface. Posterior limit = max over all cage surface nodes of the displacement toward the canal (relative to C3 and C4), not the centre; 1 mm limit on the max node displacement; report spin and its ratchet per cycle
Define 'cage centre' exactly (volume centroid of all solid voxels) and add a separate limit on spin (e.g. corner displacement) and on lost contact area per face

summary_zh: 目前判斷 cage 是否滑出（S9），只看 cage「中心點」移動了多少；但會壓到脊髓的，是 cage 最靠後方的那一點，不是中心。設計者可以利用這個差別。（一）旋轉：目前規定只算平移、不算旋轉，而軸向旋轉正是 cage 接觸面承受扭轉最大的方向（大約 1.1 牛頓米）。cage 只要原地轉 4.1 度，角落就會移動 0.5 毫米，已經達到往後滑移的上限，但中心點的移動是零，所以判定為通過。（二）軟的附屬部分：設計可以有一個硬而固定良好的核心，再加上軟的後方突出部分；突出部分可以往脊髓方向移動或鼓起超過 0.5 毫米，而中心點幾乎不動。此外，「中心點」到底怎麼定義，目前沒有寫清楚。（三）脫離接觸：判定標準沒有檢查某一面是否完全離開終板。建議改成檢查 cage 表面上所有點往後方的最大位移，並另外限制旋轉量和接觸面積的流失。
